programme.desc: Dhaese and Sylvie renew their wedding vows with a big party in the misery. In the meantime, 4 addresses are being taken into account. The burglaries clearly bear the signature of "De Smartmen", a dangerous criminal who flew behind bars 15 years ago by the 4 victims because of several burglaries, robbed and even a murder. Chantal, as the only non-involvement, takes the lead of the investigation. Is this the revenge of the smart ones? Does he want to show that he still has power, even from behind the prison walls? If so, what can they still expect? After all, the smart cannot be fooled, they know that! / DHaese en Sylvie hernieuwen hun huwelijksgeloften met een groot feest in De Miserie. Ondertussen wordt er ingebroken op 4 adressen. Dat van de korpschef, van Cloedt, van DHaese en van Meeuws. De inbraken dragen duidelijk de handtekening van "De Slimmen", een gevaarlijke crimineel die 15 jaar geleden door de 4 gedupeerden achter de tralies vloog wegens meerdere inbraken, overvallen en zelfs een moord. Chantal, als enige niet-betrokkene, neemt de leiding van het onderzoek op zich. Is dit de wraak van De Slimmen? Wil hij tonen dat hij nog steeds macht heeft, zelfs vanachter de gevangenismuren? Als dat zo is, waar kunnen ze zich dan nog aan verwachten? Met De Slimme valt immers niet te sollen, dat weten ze!

programme.desc: The six -part documentary series exploring the history of the cult, globally significant role of the Pope, one of the most respected and most beloved figures. One world leader .. with military, political and religious power remains wrapped in a veil of secrets, despite the unimaginable influence through the history and use of his power to design the flow of world history. Svaka od šest epizoda ispituje ključni historijski trenutak, u promjenjivoj dinamici ove iznimno snažne uloge i istražuje kako su papa i crkva zauzeli položaj koji danas imaju. Jedan svjetski vođa.. s vojnom, političkom i vjerskom moći ostaje obavijen velom tajne, uprkos nezamislivom utjecaju kroz historiju i korištenju svoje moći da bi oblikovao tok svjetske historije. Zahvaljujući pristupu vatikanskim arhivima i ekskluzivnim intervjuima s nekima od najistaknutijih vjerskih vođa i teologa, serija istražuje kako je 12 apostola preraslo u današnjih 1,2 milijarde katolika.

programme.desc: The mysteries of Dr. Blake (The Doctor: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) is an Australian television series first aired on ABC on February 1, 2013 at 8:30 pm [1]. Creg Dugal McLlan is in the role of Dr. Lucien Blake, who returned to Balarat, northwest of Melbourne, in the late 1950s, to take over the general medical practice of his late father and the role of a police surgeon after 30 years. Five seasons have been broadcast until 2017, after which the program is closed at the end of the fifth season. The first two seasons have 10 episodes while the next ones have 8 each. Each episode is about an hour - between 56 and 59 minutes. / Мистериите на доктор Блейк (на английски: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) е австралийски телевизионен сериал, излъчен за първи път по ABC на 1 февруари 2013 г. в 20:30 часа[1]. Пет сезона се излъчват до 2017 г., след което програмата е закрита в края на петия сезон. Първите два сезона имат 10 епизода докато следващите имат по 8. Висшата лига е най-гледаната спортна лига и най-богатото първенство в света. Надпреварата е основана през 1888 като Първа дивизия и трансформирана през 1992 като Висша лига. programme.desc: Mountains - (S02, E04, Educational Program, Croatia, 2024) Theater director Dora Ruzdjak Podolski takes us to Žumberak Gorje, a hilly area that is almost abandoned even though it is near Zagreb. Mountaineers from all over Croats and our Dora embark on Dragojla's march - dressed like 19th -century women, in skirts and lace shirts. But while Dragojla climbed barefoot through the shrubs and across the rocks, our hikers also help cables and wedges. And, of course - Gojzerica. Planinarke iz cijele Hrvateske i naša Dora kreću na Dragojlin pohod - odjevene poput žena iz 19. stoljeća, u suknjice i čipkaste košulje. Rudolf discovers him in time and tries to prove that he is able to protect his family. Albert, with the help of Walli and Gustav, abducts Rudolf and blackmail the Emperor: he seeks his life in exchange for Crown Prince. But the letter first reaches the Sisa's hands, which moves to save his son herself. Albert then lets Walli and Gustav, but all three are on the verge of strength. Unatoč nesuglasicama, s Franjom dočekuje ruskog cara na pregovorima o mirovnom savezu. U međuvremenu, Grunne potiče radnike na štrajk, a Franjo odlučuje osobno krenuti protiv njih. U raciji pogibaju Gustavov i Albertov otac. Walli vodi Gustava k svojoj kćeri u sirotište. No kada pokušaju pobjeći iz Beča, Albert ih prisili da ga odvedu u Hofburg, prijeteći djetetu. Na državnom banketu, dok Sisi i Franjo pregovaraju s ruskim carem, Albert u susjednoj prostoriji cilja pištoljem u njih. Kad jednog dana zatraži razvod, suprug će učiniti sve da je odobrovolji - čak će je povesti i na romantično putovanje u Pariz. Gospodin i gospođa Bridge imaju i troje djece na pragu puberteta. Oni su: vatrena Ruth (K. Sedgwick) koja sanjari o glumačkoj karijeri, namiguša Carolyn (M. Welsh) koja se želi udati, te distancirani Douglas (R. S. Leonard) koji bi se rado prijavio u vojsku... R.: James Ivory Ul.: Paul Newman (Walter Bridge), Joanne Woodward (India Bridge), Blythe Danner (Grace Barron), Simon Callow (Dr. Alex Sauer), Kyra Sedgwick (Ruth Bridge)...

programme.title: Duel of the earth / Dulum zemlje
programme.desc: DULUM EARTH - (S03, E05, Educational Program, Croatia, 2024) The Sladic family from Plastov is known for its award -winning wines, and this episode follows the story of two brothers, Juraj and Ante Sladic, who have decided to develop in different directions. Juraj left his family business and started running a large winery in Jadrtovac, where he achieved success and lower rewards for his top quality wines. Ante remained in the family winery, focusing on the improvement of traditional varieties such as debut, marastine and Lasina and won international awards such as the prestigious "Decanter" medal. The episode explores family dynamics, their passion for viticulture and how they both achieved remarkable success on their paths. R.: Filip Filkovic ... / Dulum zemlje - (S03, E05, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2024) Obitelj Sladić iz Plastova poznata je po svojim nagrađivanim vinima, a ova epizoda prati priču dvojice braće, Jurja i Ante Sladića, koji su se odlučili razvijati u različitim smjerovima. Juraj je napustio obiteljski posao i krenuo voditi veliku vinariju u Jadrtovcu, gdje postiže uspjehe i niže nagrade za svoja vrhunska vina. Ante je ostao u obiteljskoj vinariji, fokusirajući se na unapređenje tradicionalnih sorti poput debita, maraštine i lasine te osvaja međunarodne nagrade poput prestižne "Decanter" medalje. Epizoda istražuje obiteljsku dinamiku, njihovu strast prema vinogradarstvu i kako su obojica postigli izvanredan uspjeh na svojim putevima. R.: Filip Filković...

programme.title: Stories with a concrete from Borša Stanko Ferić / Priče s končom iz borše Stanka Ferića
programme.desc: Stories with Konč from Borša Stanko Ferić - (Educational Program, Croatia, 2019) There is a rock band in Šibenik, which still maintains rehearsals after fifty years of musical experience and occasionally performing. It is a Polaris composition, gathered during the second half of the sixties when his members were high school students. Of course, they still play music just that time, which fascinates them as much as their audience. However, through their testimonies, besides musical fascinations, we can also hear a lot of interesting way about the way of life, as well as the spirit of time that ruled in Sibenik in those years - in another story with a concise, from Borša Stanko Ferić. R .: Ivo Kuzmanić Ul.: Stanko Ferić (narrator) ... / Priče s končom iz borše Stanka Ferića - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2019) U Šibeniku postoji rock band koji i nakon pedeset godina glazbenog iskustva još uvijek održava probe, a povremeno i nastupa. Riječ je o sastavu Polaris, okupljenom tijekom druge polovice šezdesetih kad su njegovi članovi bili srednjoškolci. Naravno, i dalje sviraju glazbu upravo tog vremena, koja ih jednako opčinjava, kao i njihovu publiku. Međutim, kroz njihova svjedočanstva, osim o glazbenim fascinacijama, možemo čuti i puno toga zanimljivog o tadašnjem načinu života, kao i o duhu vremena koji je tih godina vladao Šibenikom - u još jednoj priči s končom, iz borše Stanka Ferića. R.: Ivo Kuzmanić Ul.: Stanko Ferić (Narator)...

programme.desc: Gardener - (S04, E05, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2023) Summer brings great changes in the garden. There is a lot of work, but it all compensates for the abundance of the fruits we pick day by day. And when we remove the potatoes from the ground, it will remain empty space but also exhausted soil that needs to be regenerated by adding a garden compost and glistan. In this way, the same surface can be used for another cultivation cycle. However, so that the stay in the garden would not only end up in gardening jobs, it is important to find some time and to enjoy it. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Vrtlarica - (S04, E05, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Ljeto donosi velike promjene u vrtu. Posla je puno, no sve to nadoknađuje obilje plodova koje beremo iz dana u dan. A kada iz tla izvadimo i krumpire, ostat će prazan prostor ali i iscrpljeno tlo koje treba regenerirati dodavanjem vrtnog komposta i glistinca. Na taj način ista se površina može se iskoristiti za još jedan ciklus uzgoja. No kako boravak u vrtu ne bi završio samo na vrtlarskim poslovima, važno je pronaći malo vremena i za uživanje. programme.desc: Cacao - (S01, E128, feature series, Portugal, 2024) Jaime is shocked by Joan's death. Salomao prays Valdemar help to locate Joanin's cellphone. Vitoria thinks Lalá couldn't kill anyone. Quimov, Reginin and Justin's plan to indicate Marc to give up Cacau entertain Sal. Cacau and Guto come back from the plantation. Sal asks them if Marco has adapted to a new life. Cacau conceals the desire to laugh. Anita praises tyradeners on social networks, and he's embarrassed. R.: Ricardo Carreira Ul.: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala) ... / Cacao - (S01, E128, igrana serija, Portugal, 2024) Jaime je šokiran zbog Joanine pogibije. Jaime se boji da će njega optužiti za Joaninu smrt, te misli da je Lalá u to umiješana. Vitoria misli da Lalá ne bi mogla nikoga ubiti. Quimov, Reginin i Justinov plan da navedu Marca da odustane od Cacau zabavljaju Sal. Cacau i Guto se vraćaju s plantaže. Sal ih pita je li se Marco prilagodio novom životu. programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E14, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promeda owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E14, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Transamazon Highway: Between Heaven and Earth / Transamazonska magistrala: Između neba i zemlje
programme.desc: La Transamazenica Entre Ciel et Terre - (Nature. Film, France, 2023) Transamazenica looks like a 4,300 -kilometer -long scar in the heart of the Brazilian forest from which millions of tons of raw material are extracted. In his microlaka aircraft, director Sylvestra Campe leads us on a fantastic journey and offers us a view of the beautiful, rich Amazon forest from the sky, and to new, completely different economic interests in the threatened Amazon today. R .: Sylvestre Campes ... / La Transamazonica entre ciel et terre - (prirod. film, Francuska, 2023) Transamazonica izgleda poput ožiljka dugog 4.300 kilometara u srcu brazilske šume iz koje se izvlače milijuni tona sirovina. U svome mikrolakom zrakoplovu redatelj Sylvestre Campe vodi nas na fantastično putovanje i nudi nam pogled na prelijepu, bogatu amazonsku šumu s neba, te na nove, posve drukčije gospodarske interese u danas ugroženoj Amazoniji. R.: Sylvestre Campe...

programme.desc: Do we know what we eat? - (E04, Educational Program, Croatia, 2024) The largest Naples invention, the world's most popular meal and the most famous American immigrant. It's all pizza. But what is the secret of the popularity of this juicy dish? How was pizza born? What are her most common and bizarre ingredients? The search for answers took us to Italy and the US, where we also visited the world's largest pizza festival. Discover how to prepare the perfect pizza at home and how many steps she burn her calories. Meet the Hungarian Pizza and the World Pizzaiolo Champion. The episode melts in the mouth. Only on HTV. R.: Robert Knjaz ... / Znamo li što jedemo? - (E04, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2024) Najveći napuljski izum, najpopularnije svjetsko jelo i najpoznatiji američki imigrant. Sve je to pizza. No koja je tajna popularnosti ovoga sočnog jela? Kako je rođena pizza? Koji su joj najčešći i najbizarniji sastojci? Potraga za odgovorima odvela nas je u Italiju i SAD, gdje smo posjetili i najveći svjetski pizza festival. Otkrijte kako pripremiti savršenu pizzu kod kuće i koliko koraka sagorijeva njezine kalorije. Upoznajte pizzu mađaricu i svjetske pizzaiolo šampione. Epizoda se topi u ustima. Samo na HTV-u. programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E14, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promeda owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E14, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Sokol's eyes / Oči sokolove
programme.desc: Falcon eyes - (E05, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2024) on the intersection of the Mediterranean, between the lowland and coastal Croatia, is located the forest kingdom of Croatia - Gorski Kotar. This region is also rich in water, and its inhabitants like to boast the magical source of Kupa River, from which our flight starts. In the beautiful ambience of the Risnjak National Park, we will get acquainted with the wealth of forests and water of this region. Not far from Vrbovski beekeeper Sasha will introduce us to his greatest love - the one towards bees and the production of Goranic honey. Our cameras will also be accompanied by a biologist Martha, who and her husband and daughter moved to Zaseok Mošun where she grows herbs. We will also tell you the story of the magical castle of Stara Susica. In a foggy and cold morning, drone shots will also be accompanied by poets - the oldest traditional Goranian carnival group in the patrol of the Black Lug and nearby villages, where they drive winter and all that negative with their bells and masks. During the winter, we will fly over the drones above the drums of Razdolje and show you the most spectacular snow kingdom of this region. The drone will also take us to Bjelolasica, whose specialties will be told by Mirjana, one of the former Hoc Bjelolasica workers. On the border of the sea and the mainland is the green heart of Croatia, richly unexplored forests and mountains - Gorski Kotar. Join us on this trip and experience Gorski Kotar from the air, through all four seasons. R.: Filip Filkovic ... / Oči sokolove - (E05, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2024) Na razmeđi Mediterana, između nizinske i primorske Hrvatske, smjestilo se šumsko kraljevstvo Hrvatske - Gorski kotar. Ova regija bogata je i vodom, a njezini stanovnici vole se pohvaliti i magičnim izvorom rijeke Kupe odakle kreće i naš let. U prekrasnom ambijentu Nacionalnog parka Risnjak upoznat ćemo se s bogatstvom šuma i voda ove regije. Nedaleko od Vrbovskog pčelar Saša će nas upoznati sa svojom najvećom ljubavi - onom prema pčelama i proizvodnji goranskog meda. Naše kamere pratit će i biologinju Martu koja se sa suprugom i kćerkicom preselila u zaseok Mošun gdje uzgaja ljekovito bilje. Ispričat ćemo vam i priču o magičnom dvorcu Stara Sušica. U maglovito i hladno jutro, dronovske snimke pratit će i pesnike - najstariju tradicionalnu goransku karnevalsku skupinu u ophodu Crnim Lugom i obližnjim selima gdje svojim zvonima i maskama tjeraju zimu i sve ono negativno. Tijekom zime dronom ćemo preletjeti i iznad Begova Razdolja te vam prikazati najspektakularnije snježno kraljevstvo ove regije. Dron će nas dalje odvesti i na Bjelolasicu o čijim posebnostima će nam pričati Mirjana, jedna od bivših radnica HOC-a Bjelolasica. Na samoj granici mora i kopna zeleno je srce Hrvatske, bogato neistraženim šumama i planinama - Gorski kotar. Pridružite nam se na ovom putovanju te doživite Gorski kotar iz zraka, kroz sva četiri godišnja doba. R.: Filip Filković...

Just as Hank intends to propose, Amy gets the opportunity to become a journalist, the opportunity she has always been waiting for. Hank does not show her a ring that he already had ready, aware that their relationship might not survive, because Amy goes to live in Chicago. Seven years later, when the editor of all members of the editorial office requires an inventive idea for a good topic, Amy - given that the day of gratitude is approaching - proposes to write about people who are pursued by pyrotechnics and who will have the most work in those days. These people are her parents: her father has a small and not very lucrative job selling various types of rockets, and Amy knows almost everything that can be known about it. The editor accepts her proposal and she gets the opportunity to be home with her parents for gratitude for the first time after she left home. But Sammie also has news: all happy reports Amy to marry and how Amy will be her bridesmaid. With discomfort, she admits that her fiancé Hank ... Robek (Marie), Jacqueline Samuda (Gloria) ... / When Sparks Fly - (film, SAD, 2014) Amy (M. Markle) živi s roditeljima u malom mjestu. Ima dečka Hanka (C. Jacot) i najbolju prijateljicu Sammie (K. Pesic). Upravo u trenutku kad je Hank namjerava zaprositi, Amy dobiva priliku da postane novinarka, prilika koju je oduvijek čekala. Hank joj ne pokazuje prsten koji je već imao spreman, svjestan da njihova veza možda neće preživjeti, jer Amy odlazi živjeti u Chicago. Sedam godina poslije kad urednik od svih članova redakcije traži neku inventivnu ideju za dobru temu, Amy - s obzirom na to da se približava Dan zahvalnosti - predlaže da pišu o ljudima koji se bave pirotehnikom i koji će tih dana imati najviše posla. programme.title: Tandem / Tandem
programme.desc: Tandem - (S04, E07, feature series, France, 2020) at first glance, it is an ordinary burglary in the garage of the elderly lady. But the investigation soon takes on a dark turn: a woman is the mother of a serial killer, and the blood analysis found at the crime scene reveals a shocking link - the burglar shares 50 % of DNA with Lieutenant Erwan Lebellec. programme.title: Holy mountains of the world / Svete planine svijeta
programme.desc: Holy Mountains of the World - (E09, Traveling Series, Croatia) Inca, Asteci, Maya and North American Indians lived in the grace of mountain peaks. They drew knowledge and strength from the mountains. Under the highest highs of the cordillers, Mexican volcanoes and walls, people once lived nations who offered the tops of the tops of various gifts: food, animals or decorative objects, and sometimes human sacrifices. The mountain gods threatened with avalanche, thunder or wind, but also donated rain clouds that filled the lakes and rivers from which fields were irrigated. The author of the Stipe Bozic series and cameraman Josko Bojic traveling through South and North America, exploring the former beliefs in the holiness of the mountains. The natives called him the Denali or the Great, most faithful because he height dominates the vast premises of the Tundra, the Plateaus and the river valleys. Today, that top, the highest in North America, is called Mount McKinley. The first residents, experts believed, came to Alaska 30,000 years ago from Asia, through the former compound of Siberia with Alaska. It is believed that during the last ice age, 8,000 years BC, Bering's passage was frozen, which, according to the same theory, was used by the ancient peoples for migration. Accordingly, today's Eskimi, alluets and Indians come from Asia. Znanje i snagu crpili su od planina. Pod najvišim visovima Kordiljera, meksičkih vulkana i Stjenjaka nekoć su živjeli narodi koji su prinosili bogovima vrhovima različite darove: hranu, životinje ili ukrasne predmete, a katkad i ljudske žrtve. Planinski su bogovi prijetili lavinama, gromovima ili vjetrom, ali su i darivali kišne oblake što su punili jezera i rijeke odakle su se navodnjavala polja. Autor serije Stipe Božić i snimatelj Joško Bojić putuju po Južnoj i Sjevernoj Americi istražujući nekadašnja vjerovanja u svetost planina. Starosjedioci su ga zvali Denali ili Veliki, najvjerovatnije zato što visinom dominira nepreglednim prostorima tundri, prigorskih visoravni i riječnih dolina. Danas taj vrh, najviši u Sjevernoj Americi, nosi naziv Mount McKinley. Prvi stanovnici, vjeruju stručnjaci, došli su na Aljasku još prije 30.000 godina iz Azije, preko nekadašnjeg spoja Sibira s Aljaskom. Vjeruje se kako je za vrijeme posljednjeg ledenog doba, 8.000 godina prije Krista, Beringov prolaz bio zaleđen što su, po istoj teoriji, koristili stari narodi radi migracije. programme.title: Holy mountains of the world / Svete planine svijeta
programme.desc: Holy Mountains of the World - (E09, Traveling Series, Croatia) Inca, Asteci, Maya and North American Indians lived in the grace of mountain peaks. They drew knowledge and strength from the mountains. Under the highest highs of the cordillers, Mexican volcanoes and walls, people once lived nations who offered the tops of the tops of various gifts: food, animals or decorative objects, and sometimes human sacrifices. The mountain gods threatened with avalanche, thunder or wind, but also donated rain clouds that filled the lakes and rivers from which fields were irrigated. The author of the Stipe Bozic series and cameraman Josko Bojic traveling through South and North America, exploring the former beliefs in the holiness of the mountains. The natives called him the Denali or the Great, most faithful because he height dominates the vast premises of the Tundra, the Plateaus and the river valleys. Today, that top, the highest in North America, is called Mount McKinley. The first residents, experts believed, came to Alaska 30,000 years ago from Asia, through the former compound of Siberia with Alaska. It is believed that during the last ice age, 8,000 years BC, Bering's passage was frozen, which, according to the same theory, was used by the ancient peoples for migration. Accordingly, today's Eskimi, alluets and Indians come from Asia. R.: Stipe Christmas ... / Svete planine svijeta - (E09, putopisna serija, Hrvatska) Inke, Asteci, Maje i sjevernoamerički Indijanci živjeli su u milosti planinskih vrhova. Znanje i snagu crpili su od planina. Pod najvišim visovima Kordiljera, meksičkih vulkana i Stjenjaka nekoć su živjeli narodi koji su prinosili bogovima vrhovima različite darove: hranu, životinje ili ukrasne predmete, a katkad i ljudske žrtve. Planinski su bogovi prijetili lavinama, gromovima ili vjetrom, ali su i darivali kišne oblake što su punili jezera i rijeke odakle su se navodnjavala polja. Autor serije Stipe Božić i snimatelj Joško Bojić putuju po Južnoj i Sjevernoj Americi istražujući nekadašnja vjerovanja u svetost planina. Starosjedioci su ga zvali Denali ili Veliki, najvjerovatnije zato što visinom dominira nepreglednim prostorima tundri, prigorskih visoravni i riječnih dolina. Danas taj vrh, najviši u Sjevernoj Americi, nosi naziv Mount McKinley. Prvi stanovnici, vjeruju stručnjaci, došli su na Aljasku još prije 30.000 godina iz Azije, preko nekadašnjeg spoja Sibira s Aljaskom. Vjeruje se kako je za vrijeme posljednjeg ledenog doba, 8.000 godina prije Krista, Beringov prolaz bio zaleđen što su, po istoj teoriji, koristili stari narodi radi migracije. Prema tome današnji Eskimi, Alueti i Indijanci potječu iz Azije. R.: Stipe Božić...

programme.title: Croatian submarine / Hrvatsko podmorje

In order to investigate it, we had to seek the help of Mark, a researcher's boy, who rediscovered us the rich world of submarine up to a meter depth. The shallows have not always been hospitable, he hides his dangers, especially for sailors, and some species can be uncomfortable for man. The shallows also creates wealth. This was realized by the people of Dubrovnik who were brewing white gold in the shallows of Ston, sea salt. There are also medicinal shallows. Special conditions, minerals, flow, microorganisms have created sea spas in shallows. Still, the most interesting is life, and it is not just about hedgehog, star, shellfish, snail. How diverse and rich he is, a little researcher Mark will show us. R.: Miro Andrić ... / Hrvatsko podmorje - (S05, E03, znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska, 2003) Čovjek je biće gladno nepoznatog, radoznalo, ali i nestrpljivo. A to je more do koljena, popularno zvano - plićak. Da bismo ga istražili, morali smo potražiti pomoć Marka, dječaka istraživača, koji nam je ponovno otkrio bogati svijet podmorja do metra dubine. Plićak nije uvijek bio gostoljubiv, krije on svoje opasnosti, naročito za moreplovce, a i neke vrste mogu biti neugodne za čovjeka. Plićak stvara i bogatstva. To su spoznali Dubrovčani koji su u plićacima Stona brali bijelo zlato, morsku sol. Ima i ljekovitih plićaka. Posebni uvjeti, minerali, protočnost, mikroorganizmi stvorili su morska lječilišta u plićacima. Ipak, najzanimljiviji je život, a on se ne sastoji samo od ježinca, zvjezdače, školjkaša, pužića. Koliko je raznolik i bogat, pokazat će nam mali istraživač Mark. R.: Miro Andrić...

programme.title: Man and Space - Contemporary Croatian Architecture / Čovjek i prostor - suvremena hrvatska arhitektura
programme.desc: Man and space - (S02, E03, Educational Program, Croatia, 2022) Nominations for the Drago Galić Award for Best Housing in 2019. With no intrusive reconstruction of a family home, it calls a house and a parasite, a floor gabarite 10 × 10 m, with thematic extensions on all its pages, creates an extruded volume of the geometric body of the cube. The dice volume has interior functional extensions such as bedroom modules, an external staircase tower, a garage, a dark video room and - a glass parasite. The parasite is a glazed volume of polyvalent function, which can be isolated with a continuous textile membrane and thus create the illusion of belonging to the ecstatic exterior of forests within safe and regulated interior dimensions. All functional units of the house are logically lower in a cyclical-psychic relationship around the central communication vertical. The 34 residential building is located in a new residential zone near the Žnjan Beach, with a wide view of the sea. Following the default urban conditions and respecting the immediate vicinity of the sea, the building is designed with an emphasis on the intimate connection between the external and internal space. Leading the principles of Le Corbusiere's architectural project "Domino", the building was formed by a skeletal construction, with free -level columns and horizontal plates of inter -storey construction. In the heart of the Dikla, the suburbs of Zadar, created by the Stihi Multiplication of Housing Houses with tourist apartments for rent, Letilović and Pedišić, with the project "4 houses for 4 brothers", significantly raised the criteria of design and hybrid typology inherent in the Croatian coastal. Although it is a dominant type along the coastal construction and the most widespread cause of the devastation of the landscape of the eastern Adriatic, this task does not advise the interests of the architects. Letilovic and Pedisic approached this "controversial" typology through pure architectural themes. R .: Željko Sarić Ul.: Marinko Les (Narrator) ... / Čovjek i prostor - (S02, E03, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2022) Nominacije za nagradu Drago Galić za najbolje stambeno oblikovanje u 2019. godini. Ničim nametljiva rekonstrukcija obiteljske kuće naziva Kuća i parazit, tlocrtnog gabarita 10 × 10 m, s tematskim ekstenzijama na svim svojim stranicama, stvara ekstrudirani volumen geometrijskog tijela kocke. Volumen kocke ima interijerske funkcionalne ekstenzije poput modula spavaćih soba, tornja vanjskog stubišta, garaže, mračne video sobe i - staklenog parazita. Parazit je ostakljeni volumen polivalentne funkcije, koji se kontinuiranom tekstilnom opnom može po potrebi izolirati i tako stvoriti iluziju pripadanja ekstatičnom eksterijeru šume unutar sigurnih i reguliranih interijerskih gabarita. Sve funkcionalne cjeline kuće se logično nižu u cikličko-spiralnoj vezi oko centralne komunikacijske vertikale. Stambena zgrada 34 nalazi se u novonastaloj stambenoj zoni u blizini plaže Žnjan, sa širokim pogledom na more. Slijedeći zadane urbanističke uvjete te uvažavajući neposrednu blizinu mora, zgrada je projektirana s naglaskom na prisnoj povezanosti vanjskog i unutrašnjeg prostora. Vodeći se načelima Le Corbusiereova arhitektonskog projekta "Domino", zgrada je formirana skeletnom konstrukcijom, sa slobodnostojećim stupovima i horizontalnim pločama međukatne konstrukcije. U srcu Dikla, predgrađa Zadra nastalog stihijskim multipliciranjem stambenih kuća s turističkim apartmanima za iznajmljivanje, Letilović i Pedišić su projektom "4 kuće za 4 brata" bitno podignuli kriterije oblikovanja te hibridne tipologije svojstvene hrvatskom priobalju. Iako se radi o dominantnom tipu duž obalne izgradnje i najraširenijem uzroku devastacije krajolika istočnog Jadrana, ovaj zadatak nedovoljno zaokuplja interese arhitekata. Letilović i Pedišić prišli su toj "kontroverznoj" tipologiji kroz čiste arhitektonske teme. R.: Željko Sarić Ul.: Marinko Leš (Narrator)...

programme.title: Liburnia Film Festival 2025 - Chronicles / Liburnia Film Festival 2025. - kronike
programme.desc: Liburnia Film Festival 2025 - Chronicles - (E03, Artistic Magazine, Croatia, 2025) The Liburnia Film Festival is the oldest festival dedicated to the Croatian documentary. For more than two decades, she has been following, promoting and rewarding domestic documentary production. This year's 23rd edition is held from August 26 to August 30 at recognizable festival locations - the Opatija Summer Stage and Vili Antonio. The audience expects the selection of the best recent Croatian documentaries, but the festival is not only a screening of films, but also a place of active dialogue and education. The Liburnia Film Festival also brings a discursive program as part of the stands and conversations with the authors, which provide the audience with insight into the film creation, motives, challenges and context behind the camera. In addition to great films and interesting conversations with the authors, children and young people have the opportunity to get involved in the workshops that provide them with an introduction to the documentary world, develop media literacy and encourage creative expression. With the rich program of the Liburnia Film Festival, this year it opens up space for watching, learning and dialogue ... / Liburnia Film Festival 2025. - kronike - (E03, umjetnički magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Liburnia Film Festival najstariji je festival posvećen isključivo hrvatskom dokumentarnom filmu. Već više od dva desetljeća prati, promovira i nagrađuje domaću dokumentarističku produkciju. Ovogodišnje, 23. izdanje održava se od 26. do 30. kolovoza na prepoznatljivim festivalskim lokacijama - opatijskoj Ljetnoj pozornici i Vili Antonio. Publiku očekuje selekcija najboljih recentnih hrvatskih dokumentaraca, no Festival nije samo projekcija filmova, već i mjesto aktivnog dijaloga i edukacije. Liburnia Film Festival donosi i diskurzivni program u sklopu kojeg se održavaju tribine i razgovori s autorima, koji publici omogućuju uvid u proces nastanka filma, motive, izazove i kontekst iza kamere. Osim sjajnih filmova i zanimljivih razgovora s autorima, djeca i mladi imaju se priliku uključiti u radionice koje im pružaju uvod u svijet dokumentarnog filma, razvijaju medijsku pismenost i potiču kreativno izražavanje. programme.title: 67. Split Summer / 67. Splitsko ljeto
programme.desc: Split Summer - (Entertainment Program, Croatia) We bring the performance of the opera one -inch "Cavleria Rustica" ("Rural Knight"), Italian composer Pietra Mascagni, with the 67th Split Summer 2021. Verge, who was known for the realistic representations of life from his native Sicily. This first veristics opened Verdi himself, and even today, 130 years after his performance, he continues to delight the audience around the world. At the time of Mascagni's death in 1945, only 14,000 times were performed in Italy. The action of this popular opera was located in the 19th century, in a small Sicilian place on Easter morning. Powerful music and a dramatic plot of the shop grew from the hot Sicilian temperament speaks of love, jealousy, unbelief, longing, hypocrisy and fatal revenge. The choir and orchestra of the Croatian National Theater Split. Ivo Lipanovic, winner of the "Judita" award in the music program of the 66th of Split Summer, and is directed by Jelena Bosancic. The title roles are interpreted by: Santuzza, Kristina Kolar, Sopran, Lola, Antonia Teskera, MezzoSoSoprano, Turidda, Max Jotta, Tenor, Alfio, Paolo Gavanelli, Bariton, Lucia, Stefany Findrik, ALT. Splitskog ljeta 2021. Libretisti su Giovanni Targioni - Tozzetti i Guido Menasci, a kao osnova poslužio im je istoimeni kratki roman pisca Giovannija Verge koji je bio poznat po realističnim prikazima života iz rodne mu Sicilije. Ova prva veristička opera oduševila je i samog Verdija, a i danas, 130 godina nakon praizvedbe, nastavlja oduševljavati publiku diljem svijeta. U vrijeme Mascagnijeve smrti 1945. godine samo u Italiji je bila izvedena 14.000 puta. Radnja ove popularne opere smještena je u 19. stoljeću, u malom sicilijanskom mjestu na uskršnje jutro. Moćna glazba te dramatičan zaplet radnje izrastao iz vrelog sicilijanskog temperamenta govori o ljubavi, ljubomori, nevjeri, čežnji, licemjerju i fatalnoj osveti. Zborom i orkestrom HNK Split ravna mo. Ivo Lipanović, dobitnik nagrade "Judita" u glazbenom programu 66. Splitskog ljeta, a režiju potpisuje Jelena Bosančić. Naslovne uloge tumače: SANTUZZA, Kristina Kolar, sopran, LOLA, Antonija Teskera, mezzosopran, TURIDDU, Max Jotta, tenor, ALFIO, Paolo Gavanelli, bariton, LUCIA, Stefany Findrik, alt. programme.title: I breathe, I dig, Crying ... / Dišem, kopam, čeprkam...
programme.desc: I breathe, I dig, Ceprkam ... - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2014) when a project of social urban gardens began in Varaždin, where city people, for various reasons, began to cultivate the land, no one could imagine the proportions of that story. To some, it was an escape from stressful everyday life, almost therapeutic action - with direct contact with "Mother Nature", others, however, a way to ensure existence for themselves and families ... People meet the most different educational and cultural profiles and origin: the actress of the Varazdin HNK, who says she thought she would form a garden The country finds peace to fight for life's disabilities ... The country heals and re -brings people again - the former spouses transforms into friends ... And over time, people who did not know each other at all, developing mutual solidarity, become members of a small compact community. R .: Milka Barisic ... / Dišem, kopam, čeprkam... - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2014) Kada je u Varaždinu započeo projekt društvenih urbanih vrtova gdje su gradski ljudi, iz različitih razloga, započeli obrađivati zemlju, nitko nije mogao zamisliti razmjere te priče. Nekima je to bio bijeg iz stresne svakodnevice, gotovo terapeutskog djelovanja - uz neposredan kontakt s "Majčicom Prirodom", drugima pak način da osiguraju egzistenciju sebi i obitelji... Na malim parcelama susreću se ljudi najrazličitijih obrazovnih i kulturoloških profila i podrijetla: glumica varaždinskog HNK-a, koja kaže da je mislila da će ona oblikovati vrt, a vrt je počeo oblikovati nju, samohrana majka i umjetnica koja na zemlji nalazi potreban mir za borbu sa životnim poteškoćama... Zemlja ozdravljuje i ponovno zbližava ljude - bivše supružnike pretvara u prijatelje... A s vremenom ljudi koji se uopće nisu poznavali, razvijajući međusobnu solidarnost, postaju članovi male kompaktne zajednice. R.: Milka Barišić...

programme.title: Man and Space - Contemporary Croatian Architecture / Čovjek i prostor - suvremena hrvatska arhitektura
programme.desc: Man and space - (S02, E03, Educational Program, Croatia, 2022) Nominations for the Drago Galić Award for Best Housing in 2019. With no intrusive reconstruction of a family home, it calls a house and a parasite, a floor gabarite 10 × 10 m, with thematic extensions on all its pages, creates an extruded volume of the geometric body of the cube. The dice volume has interior functional extensions such as bedroom modules, an external staircase tower, a garage, a dark video room and - a glass parasite. The parasite is a glazed volume of polyvalent function, which can be isolated with a continuous textile membrane and thus create the illusion of belonging to the ecstatic exterior of forests within safe and regulated interior dimensions. All functional units of the house are logically lower in a cyclical-psychic relationship around the central communication vertical. The 34 residential building is located in a new residential zone near the Žnjan Beach, with a wide view of the sea. Following the default urban conditions and respecting the immediate vicinity of the sea, the building is designed with an emphasis on the intimate connection between the external and internal space. Leading the principles of Le Corbusiere's architectural project "Domino", the building was formed by a skeletal construction, with free -level columns and horizontal plates of inter -storey construction. In the heart of the Dikla, the suburbs of Zadar, created by the Stihi Multiplication of Housing Houses with tourist apartments for rent, Letilović and Pedišić, with the project "4 houses for 4 brothers", significantly raised the criteria of design and hybrid typology inherent in the Croatian coastal. Although it is a dominant type along the coastal construction and the most widespread cause of the devastation of the landscape of the eastern Adriatic, this task does not advise the interests of the architects. Letilovic and Pedisic approached this "controversial" typology through pure architectural themes. R .: Željko Sarić Ul.: Marinko Les (Narrator) ... / Čovjek i prostor - (S02, E03, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2022) Nominacije za nagradu Drago Galić za najbolje stambeno oblikovanje u 2019. godini. Ničim nametljiva rekonstrukcija obiteljske kuće naziva Kuća i parazit, tlocrtnog gabarita 10 × 10 m, s tematskim ekstenzijama na svim svojim stranicama, stvara ekstrudirani volumen geometrijskog tijela kocke. Volumen kocke ima interijerske funkcionalne ekstenzije poput modula spavaćih soba, tornja vanjskog stubišta, garaže, mračne video sobe i - staklenog parazita. Parazit je ostakljeni volumen polivalentne funkcije, koji se kontinuiranom tekstilnom opnom može po potrebi izolirati i tako stvoriti iluziju pripadanja ekstatičnom eksterijeru šume unutar sigurnih i reguliranih interijerskih gabarita. Sve funkcionalne cjeline kuće se logično nižu u cikličko-spiralnoj vezi oko centralne komunikacijske vertikale. Stambena zgrada 34 nalazi se u novonastaloj stambenoj zoni u blizini plaže Žnjan, sa širokim pogledom na more. Slijedeći zadane urbanističke uvjete te uvažavajući neposrednu blizinu mora, zgrada je projektirana s naglaskom na prisnoj povezanosti vanjskog i unutrašnjeg prostora. Vodeći se načelima Le Corbusiereova arhitektonskog projekta "Domino", zgrada je formirana skeletnom konstrukcijom, sa slobodnostojećim stupovima i horizontalnim pločama međukatne konstrukcije. U srcu Dikla, predgrađa Zadra nastalog stihijskim multipliciranjem stambenih kuća s turističkim apartmanima za iznajmljivanje, Letilović i Pedišić su projektom "4 kuće za 4 brata" bitno podignuli kriterije oblikovanja te hibridne tipologije svojstvene hrvatskom priobalju. Iako se radi o dominantnom tipu duž obalne izgradnje i najraširenijem uzroku devastacije krajolika istočnog Jadrana, ovaj zadatak nedovoljno zaokuplja interese arhitekata. Letilović i Pedišić prišli su toj "kontroverznoj" tipologiji kroz čiste arhitektonske teme. R.: Željko Sarić Ul.: Marinko Leš (Narrator)...

programme.title: Classics to the people / Klasici narodu
programme.desc: Classics to the people - (Artistic Magazine, Croatia, 2015) How is it a poor student of law in Russia? Certainly not very fun. Especially when your mom writes that she will marry your sister for a rich merchant to help you with your studio. Then what is left for you to faint the "grandmother" for finance with the ax? Every crime has its sentence, and this "crime and punishment" is one of the most famous works of Russian classical literature. The life of Rasoljkovo, his thoughts, dilemmas and fears are told by bakers and zoo staff in the "Classics of the People". It is not a crime or a punishment to read the classic acts of various. Listen to an unhearded version of crime and punishment. R.: Robert Knjaz ... / Klasici narodu - (umjetnički magazin, Hrvatska, 2015) Kako je biti siromašni student prava u Rusiji? Sigurno ne baš zabavno. Pogotovo kada ti mama piše kako će udati sestru za bogatog trgovca kako bi ti pomogla sa studijem. Što ti onda preostaje nego da zbog financija sjekirom zatučeš lihvarsku "babu"? Svaki zločin ima svoju kaznu, a ovaj "Zločin i kazna" jedno je od najpoznatijih djela ruske klasične književnosti. O životu Raskoljnikova, njegovim mislima, dilemama i strahovima pričaju nam pekari i djelatnici Zoološkog vrta u "Klasicima narodu". Nije zločin niti je kazna čitati klasična djela razna. programme.title: Holy mountains of the world / Svete planine svijeta
programme.desc: Holy Mountains of the World - (E10, Traveling Series, Croatia, 2005) Alpine Tips Materhorn, Mont Blanc and Eiger have caused the imagination of the first inhabitants of Europe with their lines. German, Celtic and Illyrian gods are rooted from their eastern relatives. The Slavs had a three -headed god at the tops of the mountains. The priests of that idol claimed that Troglav or Triglav had three heads because there was three kingdoms - heaven, earth and hell. The name of the three -headed god is preserved in the terms of the highest mountains and mountain peaks such as Troglav on Dinara or Triglav in Slovenia. With the arrival of Christianity, crosses, chapels or churches are being built on the holy peaks, and many Christian rites are introduced by some caught rituals. The mountains are demitologized. The first conquerors at the tops of the mountains found no deity. However, similar to in the mythology of the Inca, the mountains, as part of the untouched nature, they are increasingly becoming deities on its own. At the same time, movements for preserving the purity of mountains are created everywhere around the world. New myths around the highest peaks of the world are also created. Many today, like former creators of epic, describe their ups as heroic works that often transcend human capabilities. R.: Stipe Christmas ... / Svete planine svijeta - (E10, putopisna serija, Hrvatska, 2005) Alpski vrhovi Materhorn, Mont Blanc i Eiger svojim su linijama izazivali maštu prvih stanovnika Europe. Germanski, keltski i ilirski bogovi vuku korijene od njihovih istočnih rođaka. Slaveni su na vrhovima planina imali troglavog boga. Svećenici tog idola tvrdili su da Troglav ili Triglav ima tri glave jer vlada trima kraljevstvima - nebom, zemljom i paklom. Ime troglavog boga sačuvano je u nazivlju najviših planina i planinskih vrhova kao što su Troglav na Dinari ili Triglav u Sloveniji. Dolaskom kršćanstva na svetim se vrhovima grade križevi, kapelice ili crkve, a u mnoge kršćanske obrede uvode se i neki zatečeni rituali. Planine su demitologizirane. Prvi osvajači na vrhovima planina nisu našli nijedno božanstvo. Svejedno, slično kao u mitologiji Inka, planine, kao dio netaknute prirode, sve više postaju božanstva sama. Istodobno se svugdje po svijetu stvaraju pokreti za očuvanje čistoće planina. Stvaraju se i novi mitovi oko najviših vrhova svijeta. Mnogi danas, poput nekadašnjih tvoraca epova, opisuju svoje uspone kao junačka djela koja često nadilaze ljudske mogućnosti. R.: Stipe Božić...

programme.title: Croatian submarine / Hrvatsko podmorje
programme.desc: Croatian submarine - (S05, E04, known. Pop. Series, Croatia, 2003) Streets, buildings, traffic, population, crowds, night lights - all this describes cities, cities on the mainland that are built by people. The diversity and population in a limited area may be easiest to describe cities. When that criterion, diversity and population in a limited area are applied to the submarine, the doors of fascinating sea cities are opened to us, and then it is easy to see that human cities are just a pale copy. One of the most important marine cities is the meadows of Posidonia. There are also buildings alive. One moist grass is a space of residence of various species. And there is no such elastic and high building on the mainland. Stone is a historical building material of coastal cities. And so in the submarine. The stone is both the substrate and the apartment, but the forces that form it are much slower, and the stonemasons and the tenants are more unusual. The sea still overtook us somewhere, in recycling. Some of the most beautiful marine cities are found on the shipwrecks that are often waste for us. R.: Miro Andrić ... / Hrvatsko podmorje - (S05, E04, znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska, 2003) Ulice, zgrade, promet, napučenost, gužva, noćna svjetla - sve to opisuje gradove, gradove na kopnu koje grade ljudi. Raznolikost i napučenost na ograničenom prostoru možda najlakše opisuje gradove. Kada taj kriterij, raznolikost i napučenost na ograničenom prostoru primijenimo na podmorje, otvaraju nam se vrata fascinantnih morskih gradova, a onda lako uviđamo da su ljudski gradovi tek blijeda kopija. Jedan od najvažnijih morskih gradova su livade posidonije. Tu su i zgrade žive. Jedna vlat trave prostor je stanovanja raznih vrsta. A na kopnu ne postoji tako elastična i visoka građevina. Kamen je povijesni građevni materijal primorskih gradova. I u podmorju je tako. Kamen je i podloga i stan, ali sile koje ga formiraju su puno sporije, a klesari i stanari neobičniji. More nas je još negdje preteklo, u recikliranju. Neke od najljepših morskih gradova nalazimo na brodskim olupinama koje su za nas često otpad. R.: Miro Andrić...

Kako su Vrtuljići često nespretni, u novom svijetu o kojem djeca znaju više od njih, njihovi će pokušaji i pogreške djecu nasmijati, a kroz zabavu će i sama (ili tijekom gledanja serije uz roditelje i starije) ponešto i naučiti...

programme.title: Holy mountains of the world / Svete planine svijeta
programme.desc: Holy Mountains of the World - (E10, Traveling Series, Croatia, 2005) Alpine Tips Materhorn, Mont Blanc and Eiger have caused the imagination of the first inhabitants of Europe with their lines. German, Celtic and Illyrian gods are rooted from their eastern relatives. The Slavs had a three -headed god at the tops of the mountains. The priests of that idol claimed that Troglav or Triglav had three heads because there was three kingdoms - heaven, earth and hell. The name of the three -headed god is preserved in the terms of the highest mountains and mountain peaks such as Troglav on Dinara or Triglav in Slovenia. With the arrival of Christianity, crosses, chapels or churches are being built on the holy peaks, and many Christian rites are introduced by some caught rituals. The mountains are demitologized. The first conquerors at the tops of the mountains found no deity. However, similar to in the mythology of the Inca, the mountains, as part of the untouched nature, they are increasingly becoming deities on its own. At the same time, movements for preserving the purity of mountains are created everywhere around the world. New myths around the highest peaks of the world are also created. Many today, like former creators of epic, describe their ups as heroic works that often transcend human capabilities. R.: Stipe Christmas ... / Svete planine svijeta - (E10, putopisna serija, Hrvatska, 2005) Alpski vrhovi Materhorn, Mont Blanc i Eiger svojim su linijama izazivali maštu prvih stanovnika Europe. Germanski, keltski i ilirski bogovi vuku korijene od njihovih istočnih rođaka. Slaveni su na vrhovima planina imali troglavog boga. Svećenici tog idola tvrdili su da Troglav ili Triglav ima tri glave jer vlada trima kraljevstvima - nebom, zemljom i paklom. Ime troglavog boga sačuvano je u nazivlju najviših planina i planinskih vrhova kao što su Troglav na Dinari ili Triglav u Sloveniji. Dolaskom kršćanstva na svetim se vrhovima grade križevi, kapelice ili crkve, a u mnoge kršćanske obrede uvode se i neki zatečeni rituali. Planine su demitologizirane. Prvi osvajači na vrhovima planina nisu našli nijedno božanstvo. Svejedno, slično kao u mitologiji Inka, planine, kao dio netaknute prirode, sve više postaju božanstva sama. Istodobno se svugdje po svijetu stvaraju pokreti za očuvanje čistoće planina. Stvaraju se i novi mitovi oko najviših vrhova svijeta. Mnogi danas, poput nekadašnjih tvoraca epova, opisuju svoje uspone kao junačka djela koja često nadilaze ljudske mogućnosti. R.: Stipe Božić...

programme.desc: Croatian submarine - (S05, E04, known. Pop. Series, Croatia, 2003) Streets, buildings, traffic, population, crowds, night lights - all this describes cities, cities on the mainland that are built by people. The diversity and population in a limited area may be easiest to describe cities. When that criterion, diversity and population in a limited area are applied to the submarine, the doors of fascinating sea cities are opened to us, and then it is easy to see that human cities are just a pale copy. One of the most important marine cities is the meadows of Posidonia. There are also buildings alive. One moist grass is a space of residence of various species. And there is no such elastic and high building on the mainland. Stone is a historical building material of coastal cities. And so in the submarine. The stone is both the substrate and the apartment, but the forces that form it are much slower, and the stonemasons and the tenants are more unusual. The sea still overtook us somewhere, in recycling. Some of the most beautiful marine cities are found on the shipwrecks that are often waste for us. R.: Miro Andrić ... / Hrvatsko podmorje - (S05, E04, znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska, 2003) Ulice, zgrade, promet, napučenost, gužva, noćna svjetla - sve to opisuje gradove, gradove na kopnu koje grade ljudi. Kada taj kriterij, raznolikost i napučenost na ograničenom prostoru primijenimo na podmorje, otvaraju nam se vrata fascinantnih morskih gradova, a onda lako uviđamo da su ljudski gradovi tek blijeda kopija. Jedan od najvažnijih morskih gradova su livade posidonije. Tu su i zgrade žive. Jedna vlat trave prostor je stanovanja raznih vrsta. A na kopnu ne postoji tako elastična i visoka građevina. Kamen je povijesni građevni materijal primorskih gradova. I u podmorju je tako. Kamen je i podloga i stan, ali sile koje ga formiraju su puno sporije, a klesari i stanari neobičniji. More nas je još negdje preteklo, u recikliranju. Neke od najljepših morskih gradova nalazimo na brodskim olupinama koje su za nas često otpad. R.: Miro Andrić...

programme.title: 67. Split Summer / 67. Splitsko ljeto
programme.desc: Split Summer - (Entertainment Program, Croatia) We bring the performance of the opera one -inch "Cavleria Rustica" ("Rural Knight"), Italian composer Pietra Mascagni, with the 67th Split Summer 2021. Verge, who was known for the realistic representations of life from his native Sicily. This first veristics opened Verdi himself, and even today, 130 years after his performance, he continues to delight the audience around the world. At the time of Mascagni's death in 1945, only 14,000 times were performed in Italy. The action of this popular opera was located in the 19th century, in a small Sicilian place on Easter morning. Powerful music and a dramatic plot of the shop grew from the hot Sicilian temperament speaks of love, jealousy, unbelief, longing, hypocrisy and fatal revenge. The choir and orchestra of the Croatian National Theater Split. Ivo Lipanovic, winner of the "Judita" award in the music program of the 66th of Split Summer, and is directed by Jelena Bosancic. The title roles are interpreted by: Santuzza, Kristina Kolar, Sopran, Lola, Antonia Teskera, MezzoSoSoprano, Turidda, Max Jotta, Tenor, Alfio, Paolo Gavanelli, Bariton, Lucia, Stefany Findrik, ALT. R .: Tvrtko Grgić ... / Splitsko ljeto - (zabavni program, Hrvatska) Donosimo izvedbu operne jednočinke "Cavalleria rusticana" ("Seosko viteštvo"), talijanskog skladatelja Pietra Mascagnija, sa 67. Splitskog ljeta 2021. Libretisti su Giovanni Targioni - Tozzetti i Guido Menasci, a kao osnova poslužio im je istoimeni kratki roman pisca Giovannija Verge koji je bio poznat po realističnim prikazima života iz rodne mu Sicilije. Ova prva veristička opera oduševila je i samog Verdija, a i danas, 130 godina nakon praizvedbe, nastavlja oduševljavati publiku diljem svijeta. U vrijeme Mascagnijeve smrti 1945. godine samo u Italiji je bila izvedena 14.000 puta. Radnja ove popularne opere smještena je u 19. stoljeću, u malom sicilijanskom mjestu na uskršnje jutro. Moćna glazba te dramatičan zaplet radnje izrastao iz vrelog sicilijanskog temperamenta govori o ljubavi, ljubomori, nevjeri, čežnji, licemjerju i fatalnoj osveti. Zborom i orkestrom HNK Split ravna mo. Ivo Lipanović, dobitnik nagrade "Judita" u glazbenom programu 66. Splitskog ljeta, a režiju potpisuje Jelena Bosančić. Naslovne uloge tumače: SANTUZZA, Kristina Kolar, sopran, LOLA, Antonija Teskera, mezzosopran, TURIDDU, Max Jotta, tenor, ALFIO, Paolo Gavanelli, bariton, LUCIA, Stefany Findrik, alt. programme.title: On the edge / Na rubu
programme.desc: On the edge - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2010) on the edge of the city, in Zagreb's Dubrava, more and more young people are starting to train at the Leonardo boxing club, led by world -renowned Leonard Petraj coach. Although Petraj trained many champions, he opened the door of his club and the "problematic kids" with whom he works for free, but only on one condition - that they respect the rules of conduct that he imposed on them. The Boxing Teacher from Dubrava Leonard Petraj is a very unusual character in his environment, who does not see the rudeness in boxing, but a refined technique for the spiritual struggle with himself and becoming a better man. On the other side of the building where the boxing club is located is a folk cuisine that comes on the edge of existence every day, those who have lost their life battle. Some of them currently "lick the wounds" and collect strength for a new struggle, while others believe that the battle for them is permanently lost. In addition to boxers and homeless people, the third segment of the film are "Dubrave poets", the founders of the "Dirty Theater" group Davorin Bogović and Jasenko Houra. When the popular dirts were in the same years as Petra's young boxers, they composed songs on the theme of life everyday life of Dubrava, impressively recording the social picture of the workers' and immigrants on the edge of the city. The texts of their early songs are still as current today as it used to be. Today, some other kids live in Dubrava, but with always the same problems and hopes for a better tomorrow. The same streets pass some new people, preoccupied with always the same, old worries, desires and dreams. The story of the movie "On the Edge" includes an intimate confession of the protagonist and their daily life struggle in combination with music and stage comments, which makes it a kind of "documentary musical" recorded in black and white. R.: Tomislav Žaja ... / Na rubu - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2010) Na rubu grada, u zagrebačkoj Dubravi, sve više mladih počinje trenirati u boksačkom klubu "Leonardo", koji vodi svjetski poznati trener Leonard Pijetraj. Iako je Pijetraj trenirao mnoge šampione, on je otvorio vrata svoga kluba i "problematičnim klincima" s kojima radi besplatno, ali samo pod jednim uvjetom - da poštuju pravila ponašanja koja im je nametnuo. Učitelj boksa iz Dubrave Leonard Pijetraj je nadasve neobičan lik u svome okruženju, koji u boksu ne vidi grubost, već istančanu tehniku za duhovnu borbu sa samim sobom i postajanje boljim čovjekom. S druge strane zgrade u kojoj je smješten boksački klub nalazi se pučka kuhinja u koju svakodnevno dolaze ljudi na rubu egzistencije, oni koji su životnu bitku izgubili. Neki od njih trenutno "ližu rane" i prikupljaju snagu za novu borbu, dok drugi smatraju da je bitka za njih trajno izgubljena. Uz boksače i beskućnike, treći segment filma su "pjesnici Dubrave", osnivači grupe "Prljavo kazalište" Davorin Bogović i Jasenko Houra. Kad su popularni Prljavci bili istih godina kao Pijetrajevi mladi boksači, skladali su pjesme na temu životne svakodnevice Dubrave, dojmljivo zabilježivši socijalnu sliku radničke i doseljeničke četvrti na rubu grada. Tekstovi njihovih ranih pjesama i danas su jednako aktualni kao nekada. Danas u Dubravi žive neki drugi klinci, ali s uvijek istim problemima i nadama u bolje sutra. Istim ulicama prolaze neki novi ljudi, zaokupljeni uvijek istim, starim brigama, željama i snovima. Priča filma "Na rubu" obuhvaća intimne ispovijesti protagonista i njihovu svakodnevnu životnu borbu u kombinaciji s glazbeno-scenskim komentarima, što ga čini svojevrsnim "dokumentarnim mjuziklom" snimljenim u crno-bijeloj tehnici. R.: Tomislav Žaja...

programme.title: On the edge of science / Na rubu znanosti
programme.desc: On the edge of science - (known. Pop. Series, Croatia) sound as therapy? Although not widespread, the idea is not new, nor does the practice. But what happens when the kinesiology and sound-vibration therapy get touched? What are today's knowledge of sound therapies? The sound, as it passes the body, has been shown to act on numerous factors, from the autonomic nervous system to the variability of the heart rhythm. It is well reminded of traditional forms of sound therapy as well as finding out modern aspects of sound therapy that is just developing and becomes a blend of tradition and modern science ... / Na rubu znanosti - (znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska) Zvuk kao terapija? Mada nije raširena, ideja nije nova, a niti praksa. No, što se događa kad se dotaknu kineziologija i zvučno-vibracijska terapija? Kakve su današnje spoznaje o zvučnim terapijama? Pokazalo se da zvuk, dok prolazi tijelom, djeluje na mnogobrojne faktore, od autonomnog živčanog sustava do varijabilnosti srčanog ritma. Dobro se podsjetiti i tradicionalnih oblika zvučne terapije kao i saznati moderne aspekte zvučne terapije koja se tek razvija i postaje spoj tradicije i moderne znanosti...

programme.desc: The Art of Architecture - (E03, Educational Program, England, 2019) The series represents some of the most famous architects in the world. programme.title: Garage / Garaža
programme.desc: Garage - (music. Show, Croatia, 2017) Rolin Humes, Pop, Rock, Blues Quartet, gathered in 2011 during the Blues Session in the Rijeka tunnel. Their musical path is accompanied by a large number of performances and awards at music competitions and festivals. The first albums 2013 "Rolin Humes Welcome you to the Penultimate Supper 6/8" follow positive criticism and the profession and the audience, and songs from the album could be heard on foreign radio stations. Successful 2014 fulfills a large number of concerts and win at 6th Croatian Blues Challenge in Zagreb, which, as representatives of Croatia, led them to Memphis at the International Blues Challenge. In addition to performing at IBC, they play in several American cities and perform on Ditty TV. Then they released their second album "Rolin Humes Premonts Rolin Blues". During 2014 and 2015, they held 120 concerts across Europe and the US. In 2017, in Denmark they represented Croatia at the European Blues Challenge. Rolin Humes are: Emil Biscan - bass, Nikola Smiljanic - Guitar, Matej Smiljanic - Bubanj, songwriter Robert James Hudulin - vocals and piano. R .: Danko Volarić ... / Garaža - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2017) Rolin Humes, pop, rock, blues kvartet, okupio se 2011. tijekom blues sessiona u riječkom Tunelu. Njihov glazbeni put prati velik broj nastupa i nagrada na glazbenim natjecanjima i festivalima. Samostalno objavljen prvi albuma 2013. "Rolin Humes Welcomes You to the Penultimate Supper 6/8" prate pozitivne kritike, i struke i publike, a pjesme s albuma mogle su se čuti i na stranim radijskim postajama. Uspješnu 2014. ispunjava veliki broj koncerata i pobjeda na 6th Croatian Blues Challengeu u Zagrebu koja ih je, kao predstavnike Hrvatske, vodila u Memphis na International Blues Challenge. Uz nastup na IBC-ju sviraju i u nekoliko američkih gradova te nastupaju na Ditty TV. Zatim objavljuju svoj drugi album "Rolin Humes Presents Rolin Blues". Tijekom 2014. i 2015. održali su 120 koncerata diljem Europe i SAD-a. Godine 2017. u Danskoj su predstavljali Hrvatsku na European Blues Challengeu. Rolin Humes su: Emil Bišćan - bas, Nikola Smiljanić - gitara, Matej Smiljanić - bubanj, autor pjesama Robert James Hudulin - vokal i klavir. U Garaži su izveli dvije pjesme: Hit face (4.30 minuta) i I dont know what I dont wanna know and I dont go where I dont wanna go (18 minuta). R.: Danko Volarić...

programme.title: The sunny side of Prisavlje / Sunčana strana Prisavlja
programme.desc: Sunny side of Prisavlje - (Music. Video Witness, Croatia, 2020) Bang Bang published the first single on the road in September 2012, and with the second single "No matter all", they achieve the entrance to the #27 National National List HTOP40. The IHG Award for the highest entry of the new performer on this ranking is won by the fourth single "Something I was hit". With the song "I have" they present themselves to "62. Zagreb Festival (2015). Although they are not the winners of the festival, their song wins the radio ether, and the profession rewards them with Porin in the "New performer of the year" category. The debut album "No matter all" (June 2015) announces the sixth single "for the end", and the single "I have" brings them a nomination for Porin in the "Best Vocal Group" category. The following are three singles: "Don't forget me", "Truth" and "Pijani and in love". The song "Socialistically engaged in the Hip Hop Rhythm brings them a nomination for the Porin Award in the" Finding Vocal Cooperation "category. For the movie I go! ”(2020). The band, joined by Hrvoje Prskalo. The second studio album was released by the end of 2019. R.: Vesna Fijac Fodor ... / Sunčana strana Prisavlja - (glazb. videoisječak, Hrvatska, 2020) Bang Bang je prvi singl ˝Negdje na cesti˝ objavio u rujnu 2012., a već drugim singlom "Bez obzira na sve", ostvaruju ulaz na #27 službene nacionalne ljestvice HRTop40. Nagradu IHG-a za najviši ulaz novog izvođača na ovu ljestvicu osvajaju četvrtim singlom "Nešto me pogodilo". S pjesmom ˝Imam˝ predstavljaju se na ˝62. Zagrebačkom festivalu (2015.). Iako nisu pobjednici festivala, njihova pjesma osvaja radijski eter, a struka ih nagrađuje Porinom u kategoriji "Novi izvođač godine". Album prvijenac "Bez obzira na sve" (lipanj 2015.) najavljuje šesti singl "Za kraj˝, a singl "Imam" donosi im nominaciju za Porin u kategoriji "Najbolja izvedba grupe s vokalom". Tijekom 2016. slijede tri singla: ˝Ne zaboravi me˝, ˝Stranci˝ i ˝Pijani i zaljubljeni˝. Sljedeće godine bend ostvaruje prvi duet sa Sašom Antićem (TBF) u pjesmi ˝Kako stoje stvari˝. Društveno angažirani tekst vješto umotan u hip hop ritam donosi im nominaciju za nagradu Porin u kategoriji ˝Najbolja vokalna suradnja˝. Osim rada na autorskim pjesama, bend se na čelu s Hrvojem Prskalom kao kompozitorom okušao i u stvaranju glazbe za filmove "ZG80", koji je 2017. proglašen najgledanijim hrvatskim filmom, i za film ˝Ideš? Idem!˝ (2020.). Sedmu godinu postojanja bend 2019. obilježava zagrebačkim koncertom, koji prate sjajne kritike i pohvale u medijima. U lipnju 2019. nastupaju na glavnoj pozornici ˝In Music˝ festivala predstavljajući svoju glazbu domaćoj i stranoj publici. Veliki glazbeni zaokret svakako je najavio singl ˝Pismo˝ u kojem se Lari, kao glavnom vokalu benda, pridružio i Hrvoje Prskalo. Drugi studijski album MOL.2 objavljuju krajem 2019. Osigurao im je dvije nominacije za nagradu Porin u kategoriji ˝Najbolji pop album˝ i u kategoriji ˝Najbolja izvedba grupe s vokalom˝. Singl s albuma ˝Sebi dovoljni˝ predstavljen je na 67. Zagrebačkom festivalu na kojem je bend do sada nastupio četiri puta. R.: Vesna Fijačko Fodor...

programme.title: Romano Bolkovic - 1 on 1 / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1
programme.desc: Romano Bolkovic - 1 to 1 - (Talk Show, Croatia, 2025) with guest Nenad Bakic we will discuss the public concentration on Trump as a person, not the political processes he triggers on, the reasons and effects of the abolition of USAID and Harangi against Elon Musk, the fears of the oligarchy, the male and its influence, on the position of Europe, On the demographic projections of Croatia, the abolition of the fact-checking, the results of the robotic league and the stem of literacy, the AI ​​revolution, about why the problem is in education, and not so much in curriculum, about the pollution problem, how much Croats care about their health, what we should do with excess money, the boycott of stores, and the Pandemia. Nenad Bakic, entrepreneur and investor, mathematician by education, until his thirties, worked at the Mathematical Faculty in Zagreb, when he went to the world of entrepreneurship. Deals first of all finances, it is the first in Croatia to receive the prestigious Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) title. He is best known as the MojPosao portal, who once transformed employment in Croatia. Founded other companies to which he still owns. As an investor, he promoted investment in shares of Croatian tourist companies. Jury member for the EY Entrepreneur of the Year. Together with his wife, the founder and financier of the Institute for Youth Development and Innovation, whose STEM program is Croatian Makers is the largest unrestrained educational program in the European Union. He was also a leading pandemic analyst in Croatia and the author of Mrcmo epidemic model, the only one in Croatia, and thanks to his pandemic engagement, Croatia avoided rigid measures of a multitude of countries. In its analyzes, the economy, demographics, health and other important topics are touched on ... / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1 - (talk show, Hrvatska, 2025) S gostom Nenadom Bakićem razgovarat ćemo o koncentriranju javnosti na Trumpa kao osobu, a ne političke procese koje pokreće, o razlozima i učincima ukidanja USAID-a i harangi protiv Elona Muska, o bojazni od oligarhije, Muska i njegova utjecaja, o položaju Europe i današnjoj europskoj AI industriji, o budućnosti električnih automobila, o demografskim projekcijama Hrvatske, o ukidanju fact-checkinga, o rezultatima robotičke lige i STEM opismenjavanja, o AI revoluciji, o tome zašto je problem u školstvu, a ne toliko u kurikulumu, o problemu onečišćenja, o tome koliko se Hrvati brinu o svom zdravlju, o tome što bismo trebali raditi s viškom novca, o bojkotu trgovina, te o rezimeu pandemije. Nenad Bakić, poduzetnik i ulagač, matematičar po obrazovanju, do svoje tridesete radio je na Matematičkom fakultetu u Zagrebu, kada se otisnuo u svijet poduzetništva. Baveći se ponajprije financijama, prvi je u Hrvatskoj koji je dobio prestižnu titulu Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA). Najpoznatiji je po portalu MojPosao, koji je svojedobno transformirao zapošljavanje u Hrvatskoj. Osnovao i druge kompanije kojima je i dalje vlasnik. Kao ulagač promovirao je ulaganje u dionice hrvatskih turističkih kompanija. Član žirija za EY poduzetnik godine. Zajedno sa suprugom osnivač je i financijer Instituta za razvoj i inovativnost mladih, čiji je STEM program Croatian Makers najveći nedržavni obrazovni program u Europskoj uniji. Također, bio je vodeći analitičar pandemije u Hrvatskoj te autor MRCMO epidemijskog modela, jedinog u Hrvatskoj, te je zahvaljujući njegovu angažmanu za pandemije Hrvatska izbjegla rigidne mjere mnoštva država. U svojim analizama dotiče se gospodarstva, demografije, zdravlja i drugih važnih tema...
